transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because things have gotten a bit out of hand lately. Um... after I eat, especially if I feel like I've had too much, I've started going upstairs and... making myself sick. I just pretend I'm tidying up or getting ready for bed so no one notices. It's just... it's why I finally decided I should probably talk to someone.
How often do you make yourself sick after eating?

I suppose... well, it's been pretty consistent since last winter. Um... there hasn't really been a week where I haven't had at least one of those... moments where I eat too much in private. And then... you know, I try to fix it. By making myself sick, or just... not eating the next day, or walking for hours. It's... it's at least once a week, usually.
How often do you eat in private and then feel like you've had too much?

Well... like I said, about once a week. It usually happens when... when no one else is in the kitchen. 

I just... I end up going through whatever is around. Leftovers from a church supper, crackers, cheese... cookies, or whatever I baked for my book club. I eat it all in one sitting. It's... well, it's far more than I would ever actually serve myself at a meal.
How many times a week do you eat in private and then feel like you've had too much?
Um... like I just mentioned, it's... about once a week. Usually.
Do you ever eat in private and feel like you've had too much more than once a week?

I... well, no, not usually. Like I've been saying... it's just that since last winter, there has hardly been a single week where I haven't had at least one of those... spells. And then had to try and make up for it by throwing up, or skipping my meals, or... overdoing my walking. But... it's generally just the once. I don't really keep a strict count.
Do you have episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time frame more than once a week?

I... I think I just answered that. It's... it's just the once a week, usually. Like I said, since last winter, it's just been... about one time a week where I have one of those spells and then have to... fix it, by being sick or fasting or walking too much. Just... just once a week.
Do you ever make yourself sick, or fast, or exercise excessively when you haven't eaten a large amount of food in a short time frame?
No... I don't think so. It's really just... when I have one of those spells. That's the only time I feel like I need to... do something about it.
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics to try and make up for eating too much?
No... I've never done that. I just... stick to what I mentioned before.
Do you make yourself sick, fast, or exercise excessively to prevent weight gain after eating too much?

Yes... I mean, that's actually why I finally decided to come in. After I have one of those spells where I eat too much... I'll go upstairs and make myself throw up. I just... I try to act like I'm just tidying up the kitchen or getting ready for bed, so nobody notices. But yes, I do that.
Do you ever have episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time frame without feeling a loss of control?
No... I don't think so. It's... it's always the same. When I eat like that, I just... I can't stop it.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past year?
No... not really. It's stayed about the same, I think.
Do you make yourself sick after eating too much specifically to undo the calories you've consumed?
I'm not really sure... I don't think about it like that, with the calories. I just... I just feel like I need to get rid of it. That's all.
Is making yourself sick after eating too much related to trying to maintain your current weight?
I don't know... I don't really think it's about that. I just... I just do it.
Do you ever have more than one episode of eating a large amount of food in a short time frame in a single day?
No... I don't think so. It's usually just... just the once.
Are you trying to prevent weight gain when you make yourself sick after eating?
I don't... I'm not really focused on that. Like I said before, it's not really about my weight. I just... I just feel like I have to do it.
Do you ever have episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time frame that are not followed by making yourself sick, fasting, or excessive exercise?
I... no. If I eat like that, I... I always make myself sick afterwards. I don't just leave it.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short time frame without then making yourself sick?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said, I always make myself sick. I never just leave it.
Do you have episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time frame that you would describe as binge eating?

I... yes. I suppose you could call it that. When no one else is in the kitchen... I can go through a lot. Leftovers from a church supper, crackers, cheese, cookies... whatever I baked for my book club. I just eat it all in one sitting. It's... far more than I would ever actually serve myself at a meal.
Do you have episodes of binge eating more than once a week?

I... yes. I suppose so. Since last winter, um... I don't think there's been a week where I haven't had at least one of those... private spells. And then... well, I have to make up for it somehow. By throwing up, or... skipping meals... or just overdoing it with my walking.
How many times a week do you have episodes of binge eating?

I... well, I thought I just said. Like I told you, since last winter... there hasn't really been a week without at least one. Sometimes maybe two or three? It just... it happens, and then I have to deal with it.
